coverage_notes: All 36 state governor races scheduled for November 3, 2026 are included. Alaska and Kansas remained uncalled in the sources checked November 4; no winner is inferred.

Candidate-policy evidence is incomplete: 42 governor excerpts are verified, with both principal candidates represented in 17 races. Missing statements and outgoing-officeholder evidence are coverage gaps, not findings that a person has no position.

Initial ordering puts Texas, Ohio, Georgia and other states with tracked projects and moratorium activity first; it is not a national capacity ranking. Virginia and New Jersey did not hold regularly scheduled governor elections in 2026.
Local coverage is selective: Frederick County, Maryland; two Georgia utility-regulator races; and 17 ballot measures. This is not a complete national local-election inventory.

Reported results await certification. A certified vote does not by itself establish legal commencement or resolve litigation. Candidate proposals require separate government action; advisory questions do not enact moratoriums.
